message.abstract:
<jats:p>Orientation: Digital technologies, particularly artificial intelligence (AI), are rapidly transforming human resource functions by enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of human resource practices.
Research purpose: This systematic review examines the factors that facilitate the integration of AI into global talent management (GTM) and explores how these factors collectively inform theory on technology-enabled talent management systems.
Motivation for the study: Research on the use of AI in GTM remains limited, and its theoretical implications are not yet well established.
Research approach/design and method: A systematic literature review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews framework. The review encompassed eight databases (Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, ProQuest, Emerald Insight, Sabinet and Elsevier) using a comprehensive and structured search strategy. Peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2020 and 2025 were screened. Twenty-three empirical studies meeting the inclusion criteria were subjected to full-text analysis.
Main findings: The analysis revealed that AI integration into GTM is influenced by several interconnected enablers, including the strategic alignment of AI with talent objectives, adequate capabilities and digital infrastructure, ethical and governance frameworks and organisational readiness for implementation.
Practical/managerial implications: Human resources practitioners and policymakers should adopt a systemic, integrative approach that aligns AI tools with organisational talent objectives.
Contribution/value-add: This review advances theoretical discourse by integrating fragmented evidence into a cohesive understanding of the conditions that support AI-driven GTM. It offers a conceptual foundation for future research seeking to build theory at the intersection of AI, GTM and strategic human resource management.</jats:p>
title: Factors that facilitate artificial intelligence integration into global talent management: A systematic review
